QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is off by default (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` is off by default (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:2196`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that both threading macros are off by default in the shipped mbedtls_config.h, so a default build defines neither. It also admits this is inferred from `default_state` fields rather than read from the header, but it still states the fact.
